reason: A read-only TypeScript/JavaScript change-impact analysis plugin that compares Git revisions, traces affected modules, reports evidence, and ranks candidate tests.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码变更影响分析插件，可比较 Git 变更、追踪受影响模块、提供证据位置并排序候选测试。
summaries.en: A read-only TypeScript/JavaScript change-impact analysis plugin that compares Git changes, traces affected modules, provides evidence locations, and ranks candidate tests.

capabilities: Reads Git metadata and repository files through DSH services
Analyzes TypeScript and JavaScript changes and module dependencies
Returns affected files, propagation paths, evidence locations, and candidate tests
Invokes Git through argv for revision comparison
